name: ANU Student Urgent Relief Bursary (SURF)
summary: Non-repayable bursary for enrolled ANU students facing significant financial hardship from unforeseen events who need immediate help.
key: The maximum total amount disbursed may not exceed $2,000 AUD per calendar year.
who: Experiencing significant financial hardship due to unforeseen events
how: Apply via the online application form, yourself or through a referral
Upload a statement of your circumstances or a tax invoice or receipt for expenses already paid
catches: No deadline, but it runs only until current funds are fully spent
Does not cover HECS, tuition fees, SA-FEE or travel costs

evidence.quote: the maximum total amount disbursed may not exceed $2,000 AUD per calendar year.
Successful applicants do not have to repay the money (i.e. it's not a loan).
Be experiencing significant financial hardship due to unforeseen events;
